old:
def borrowed_read(tail: List<&2, M.OwnOp>) -> List<&2, M.OwnOp>:
  M.OwnRead{} <> tail

mutations.name: drop-before-read
mutations.new:
def borrowed_read(tail: List<&2, M.OwnOp>) -> List<&2, M.OwnOp>:
  M.OwnDrop{} <> M.OwnRead{} <> tail
mutations.violates: A sole initial root is destroyed before the read; a successful read becomes an explicit fault.
mutations.witness: A=Nat, cell=OwnLive{0n,7n}, tail=Nil: original OwnDone{OwnLive{0n,7n},[7n]}, mutant OwnFault{Nil}.

mutations.name: omit-read
mutations.new:
def borrowed_read(tail: List<&2, M.OwnOp>) -> List<&2, M.OwnOp>:
  tail
mutations.violates: Final roots alone do not determine equivalence: the observable read disappears.
mutations.witness: A=Nat, cell=OwnLive{0n,7n}, tail=Nil: original reads [7n], mutant reads Nil; both end with one root.

mutations.name: retain-without-release
mutations.new:
def borrowed_read(tail: List<&2, M.OwnOp>) -> List<&2, M.OwnOp>:
  M.OwnKeep{} <> M.OwnRead{} <> tail
mutations.violates: The read trace is unchanged but a temporary root leaks.
mutations.witness: A=Nat, cell=OwnLive{0n,7n}, tail=Nil: original final cell OwnLive{0n,7n}, mutant OwnLive{1n+0n,7n}; both read [7n].
